plan.description: Replica scene for testing and development - Comprehensive maintenance workflow for warehouse equipment including motor repair, toolbox management, and safety inspections

actr_architecture_manifest._note: IDs below map to initialStates entries — modules are capsule-shaped, buffers are sphere-shaped

intentional_module.role: Sets episode drive and derives initial intention payload (M1)

production_memory.role: Central rule-selection engine; fires production rules in both Branch A and B (M5)

declarative_module.role: Stores and retrieves factual knowledge; resolves tool name from schemas (M5A.3, M8)

temporal_module.role: Tracks elapsed time and temporal context across episode phases

visual_module.role: Processes visual perceptions from scene; feeds visual_buffer

manual_module.role: Controls motor/hand actions; proxy for manual_buffer in Branch B (M5B.4)

aural_module.role: Processes auditory input; proxy for aural_location_buffer in Branch B (M5B.6)

motor_module.role: Receives final motor_command from production decision; M agents freeze after this (M10)

goal_buffer.role: Holds the agent's active goal/subgoal artifact (M3)

imaginal_buffer.role: Working memory — stores task image built from intention/goal context (M2, M4)

production_buffer.role: Holds selected production rule; merge point for Branch A and B outputs (M9)

temporal_buffer.note: Temporal buffer shares the motor_module station (cognitive_005)
temporal_buffer.role: Tracks time intervals for production cycle timing

visual_buffer.role: Receives scene object data; P agent deposits observations here (P7, M5B.2)

visual_location_buffer.role: Receives spatial position data from scene scan (P7, M5B.3)

manual_buffer.note: Manual buffer proxied through manual_module station (cognitive_016)
manual_buffer.role: Stores motor execution parameters for physical actions (M5B.4)

aural_buffer.role: Receives audio context cues from environment (M5B.5)

aural_location_buffer.note: Aural location proxied through aural_module station (cognitive_017)

vocal_buffer.role: Holds vocal output to be produced (not used in primary 12-step flow)

phase_construction_order.phase_1: visual_buffer (cognitive_006) + visual_location_buffer (cognitive_007) + manual_module (cognitive_016) + aural_buffer (cognitive_009) + aural_module (cognitive_017) + vocal_buffer (cognitive_011)

12_step_phase_map.M5A: PARALLEL Branch A   → cognitive_002 → cognitive_010 → cognitive_013
12_step_phase_map.M5B: PARALLEL Branch B   → cognitive_002 → cognitive_006 → cognitive_007 → cognitive_016 → cognitive_009 → cognitive_017
12_step_phase_map.T6: DispatchPhysical    → M agents freeze / P agent activates
12_step_phase_map.P7: ReturnToBuffers     → P deposits into cognitive_006 / cognitive_007 / cognitive_016

branchA.description: All M agents traverse Branch A sequentially before the split
branchA.onComplete: freeze_M_A_at_imaginal_buffer; spawn M_B and M_C for branchB/branchC

branchB.description: M_B agent — memory retrieval path (runs parallel with Branch C after branchA split)

branchC.description: M_C agent — perceptual priming path (runs parallel with Branch B after branchA split)

physical.description: Physical agent — activated after branchB + branchC complete; scans zone and executes physical task

steps.description: Scan zone tools; deposit observations to cognitive_006/007/016
M_B resumes — cross-match scene_observations vs tool_name
M agents merge — select final action_rule from branchB+branchC outputs
M_merge hands off motor_command; all M agents freeze permanently
P agent moves to agent-specific target tool
ActionComplete — episode concludes, rewards settled, cognitive cycle reset

secondPass._description: Runs after PhysicalObservationComplete — M agents resume with real P-observed facts

M_B_secondPass.description: M_B re-reads Declarative Memory — now contains P real scene observations; resolves actual tool from observed facts (not prior knowledge)

M_C_secondPass.description: M_C re-reads Visual Buffer — now contains P injected spatial data; confirms perceptual model

M_merge.description: All M agents converge — Production Buffer merges updated branchB + branchC outputs into final action_rule

M_motor.description: Motor Module converts action_rule to motor_command; WRITES resolvedTargetId to AgentCognitiveMemory; all M agents freeze permanently
M_motor.sideEffect: AgentCognitiveMemory.resolvedTargetId = resolved tool from cognitive process

secondPass.onComplete: SecondCognitivePassComplete → P agent reads resolvedTargetId and executes

cognitiveProcessConfig._description: Runtime config consumed by MentalAgentSpawner, PhysicalObservationLoop, and BSGMLAgent

mentalAgentCount.note: 3 required (M_A/M_B/M_C); M_D=4th branchB cross-validation; M_E=5th temporal monitoring

cognitiveProcessConfig.resolvedTargetStoredBy: Motor Module step (step 10) during second cognitive pass
cognitiveProcessConfig.fallbackNote: If resolvedTargetId is null after cognitive phase, BSGMLAgent uses actionSequence[0].targetObjectId

properties._note: Working memory buffer — builds and updates the agent's internal task image (M2, M4)

cognitiveActionSequence.description: Derive episode objective — M agent visits Intentional Module to extract drive/intention payload
Build working memory image — M agent encodes task context into Imaginal Buffer
Bind active goal — M agent visits Goal Buffer to lock current subgoal artifact

branchB.description: Branch B — Production Memory fires retrieval rule; queries declarative memory for tool name
Branch B — Retrieval Buffer gates memory fetch; forwards query to Declarative Module
Branch B — Declarative Module resolves tool name from stored knowledge schemas

branchC.description: Branch C — Production Memory fires perception rule to prepare environment query
Branch C — Visual Buffer slot primed for incoming object recognition data
Branch C — Visual Location Buffer slot primed for spatial position data
Branch C — Manual Module slot primed for motor execution parameters
Branch C — Aural Buffer slot primed for audio context cues
Branch C — Aural Location slot primed for spatial audio localization data

cognitiveActionSequence.description: Mental agents freeze — physical agent P activated to scan scene environment and collect tool list/positions

P agent writes real scene observations to Declarative Memory (cognitive_013) as stored facts — each tool's id/name/position/isAvailable recorded; spatial data also injected into Visual Buffer (006), Visual Location (007), Manual Module (016); fires PhysicalObservationComplete

SECOND COGNITIVE PASS — M_B re-reads Declarative Memory (cognitive_013) which now contains P real scene observations; resolves actual available tool from observed facts (overrides first-pass hypothesis)
SECOND COGNITIVE PASS — Production Buffer merges updated branchB output (real tool_name) with branchC env_query_slots; forms final action_rule based on real-world observations

SECOND COGNITIVE PASS — Motor Module converts action_rule to motor_command; WRITES resolvedTargetId to AgentCognitiveMemory (P agent will read this); all M agents freeze permanently; fires SecondCognitivePassComplete

P agent activates — reads resolvedTargetId from AgentCognitiveMemory (written by Motor Module during second cognitive pass); moves to COGNITIVELY RESOLVED tool — NOT from static JSON actionSequence; falls back to JSON actionSequence only if resolvedTargetId is null
P agent completes task — episode concludes, all rewards settled, cognitive cycle reset for next episode

metadata.purpose: Independent replica scene for testing and development
metadata.changelog: v2.3 — Two-pass cognitive protocol: step7 depositTargets updated (cognitive_013 primary); steps 8-10 labeled SecondPass with cognitivePassNumber=2; step11 dynamicTargetResolution=true (NOT from JSON actionSequence); cognitiveProcessConfig top-level added; mentalBranchPaths enhanced with secondPass section, agentCountRange (3-5), twoPassProtocol flags

correctSequence.description: Rewards for performing actions in the correct sequence

stepCompletion.description: Reward for completing each step in sequence

skillLearning.description: Reward for successfully learning a skill at a tool

sequenceCompletion.description: Bonus reward for completing entire sequence in correct order

preconditionSatisfaction.description: Reward for satisfying all preconditions before action

incorrectSequence.description: Penalties and neutral feedback for incorrect sequences

wrongOrder.description: Penalty for performing actions out of sequence order

missingPrecondition.description: Penalty for attempting action without required preconditions

wrongTool.description: Penalty for interacting with wrong tool in sequence

skippedStep.description: Penalty for skipping a required step in sequence

neutralFeedback.description: Neutral feedback (no reward/penalty) for actions that don't match sequence but aren't harmful

positive_action_correct.description: ML correctly chooses positive action when skill sufficient

positive_action_incorrect.description: ML incorrectly chooses positive when insufficient skill

negative_action_incorrect.description: ML incorrectly chooses negative when could learn

correct_direction_reward.description: Reward when ML-Agent moves toward current step's target (from actionSequence.targetObjectId)

wrong_direction_penalty.description: Penalty when ML-Agent moves away from current step's target

target_reached_reward.description: Bonus reward when agent reaches the target object position
